tool.name: nf-core abacas
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ abacas.pl \\ -r ${fasta} \\ -q ${scaffold} \\ ${args} \\ -o ${prefix}
sort "${prefix}.bin" > "${prefix}.bin.tmp" && mv "${prefix}.bin.tmp" "${prefix}.bin" # Needs to be sorted for consistency mv nucmer.delta ${prefix}.nucmer.delta mv nucmer.filtered.delta ${prefix}.nucmer.filtered.delta mv nucmer.tiling ${prefix}.nucmer.tiling mv unused_contigs.out ${prefix}.unused.contigs.out
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": abacas: \$(echo \$(abacas.pl -v 2>&1) | sed 's/^.*ABACAS.//; s/ .*\$//') END_VERSIONS ]]>
